svg.title: t-SNE and UMAP destroy size and distance on purpose
svg.desc: Four panels comparing a twenty-dimensional truth of two small close clusters and one four-times-wider cluster 6.63 times further away, a PCA projection that preserves both ratios, and crossed-out t-SNE and UMAP projections that equalise the cluster sizes and, for UMAP, reverse the ordering, beside three struck-through claims the picture cannot support and a bottom strip where fifty-dimensional pure noise projects into three convincing blobs at silhouette 0.3461.
svg.text: t-SNE and UMAP destroy size and distance on purpose
UMAP put C NEARER than B. It
X and Y are more alike than X
there was nothing there. Its job is to make
neighbourhoods; it will make them out of noise.
...so what IS it good for? -> local neighbourhoods, nothing more
